<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 12:12">Targ. Y. II, Num. XII, 12</cite> <he>הות עמנא בעַקְנָא</he> she was with us in (shared) our trouble; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a:19">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>דא ע׳</he> that is the trouble (that thou callest them wicked).—Pl. <he>עָקָן</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 10:19">Targ. O. Lev. X, 19</cite> <he>וערען … ע׳</he> (v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 34).—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:8">Snh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>וע׳ סגיאן עתידן וכ׳</he> and great troubles are destined to come over the world; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 13:4">Tosef. Sot. XIII, 4</cite> <he>ע׳ סגיאין</he> (corr. acc.; Var. <he>ע׳ רברבן</he>); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="P01231"><he>עַקְתָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:3:2">Y. B. Kam. X, 7ᶜ</cite> top <he>בר נש דעָקִין</he> (masc. form) a man of troubles (a very poor man).
